items.source: Notification when Redis has confirmed a channel subscription.
items.translation: Redis 确认频道订阅后的通知。

items.source: Notification when Redis has confirmed a channel un-subscription.
items.translation: Redis 确认取消订阅频道后的通知。

items.source: Notification when Redis has confirmed a pattern subscription.
items.translation: Redis 确认模式订阅后的通知。

items.source: Notification when Redis has confirmed a pattern un-subscription.
items.translation: 收到 Redis 确认模式取消订阅的通知。

items.source:
Subscription notifications are reported by Redis as confirmation for subscribe and unsubscribe operations for
channels and patterns.
items.translation: Redis 将订阅通知作为对频道和模式的订阅与取消订阅操作的确认进行报告。
